children: RNS Number : 9693V  Triple Point Venture VCT PLC  23 September 2026

The Board of Triple Point Venture VCT Plc has resolved to pay an interim dividend of 2p per share to Venture Share Class Shareholders. The dividend will be paid on or around 16 December 2026 to Venture Share Class Shareholders on the register at the close of business on 27 November 2026. The ex-dividend date will be 26 November 2026.
The last date for receipt of elections in respect of the Dividend Re-investment Scheme ("DRIS") is 2 December 2026 and a further announcement on the DRIS will be released in due course.
FOR FURTHER INFORMATION ON THE COMPANY, PLEASE CONTACT
Further information on the Company can be found on its website https://www.triplepoint.co.uk/triple-point-venture-vct/
The Company is a Venture Capital Trust incorporated in July 2010 and was established to fund small and medium sized enterprises. The Investment Manager is Triple Point Investment Management LLP.
